title: Documentary Brutalist Agency
concept: OFFCUT®, a fictional Rotterdam skate brand and film unit that documents spots before the city pours over them: billboard Anton headline over three B&W documentary frames, black spot-file chapters, a warm-white position cut, a seven-step narrative collage, pale mint/pink proof cards, updates, a hard-ruled FAQ and an oversized footer wordmark.
notes: No dependencies beyond Google Fonts (Anton, Archivo). Unsplash photography stored locally and graded to greyscale in CSS. Full-screen menu is a native modal <dialog> (Escape, inert background, aria-expanded, focus return); FAQ uses <details>. Collage parallax is capped below 5% of frame height and off under prefers-reduced-motion; captions show on hover/focus and stay visible on touch.
